content:
# New ACK-Managed S3 Bucket for Logs

I'll add the logs bucket and grant permissions independently in each environment. These manifests assume the existing User and Role are named `myapp-user` and `myapp-role` respectively — adjust the `userName` and `roleName` fields to match your actual existing service principals.

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-dev
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  userName: myapp-user
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-prod
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  roleName: myapp-role
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

**Notes:**
- Each new policy grants access **only** to the logs bucket; the existing `iam.yaml` policies remain unchanged and retain access only to the assets bucket.
- Replace `myapp-user` (dev) and `myapp-role` (prod) with your actual User/Role names from the existing `iam.yaml` files.
- Apply with `kubectl apply -f dev/logs-bucket.yaml dev/logs-policy.yaml` and `kubectl apply -f prod/logs-bucket.yaml prod/logs-policy.yaml`.
